instruction:
Start from a blank Revit project. Using the Revit GUI, create a single-storey office suite with an overall rectangular footprint of 22.0 m by 14.0 m near the project origin. The exterior walls should define the full footprint and rise about 3.3 m, with one ground slab and a roof covering the footprint. Save the deliverables on the Desktop using the exact filenames required below.

The IFC export must use the IFC4 schema, have unique GlobalId values for all IfcRoot objects, and contain one IfcProject, one IfcSite, one IfcBuilding, one IfcBuildingStorey, eight IfcSpace entities, eleven IfcWall entities, one IfcSlab, one IfcRoof, seven IfcDoor entities, and six IfcWindow entities. Do not include IfcStair, IfcColumn, IfcBeam, IfcCurtainWall, or IfcBuildingElementProxy entities. Name the spaces so the normalized IfcSpace names include Reception, Open Office, at least three Meeting rooms, Pantry, Accessible Toilet, and Print Room. Export a Revit room schedule named result.csv with headers room name,area and exactly these rows: Reception=23.76, Meeting Room 1=34.56, Meeting Room 2=29.16, Meeting Room 3=18.36, Open Office=113.96, Pantry=8.16, Accessible Toilet=8.16, and Print Room=8.16. The required BIM categories must be exported as real IFC building elements/spaces, not visual-only placeholders or proxy geometry. Coordinate placement, relationship entities, GUID values, Revit type names, materials, property sets, and harmless extra metadata may vary as long as the stated model geometry, element categories, space names, schedules, sheets, and file outputs are satisfied.
